wikitext: ==Problem== Wind chill is a measure of how cold people feel when exposed to wind outside. A good estimate for wind chill can be found using this calculation (\text{wind chill}) = (\text{air temperature}) - 0.7 \times (\text{wind speed}), where temperature is measured in degrees Fahrenheit (^{\circ}\text{F}) and the wind speed is measured in miles per hour (mph). Suppose the air temperature is 36^{\circ}\text{F} and the wind speed is 18 mph. Which of the following is closest to the approximate wind chill? \textbf{(A)}\ 18 \qquad \textbf{(B)}\ 23 \qquad \textbf{(C)}\ 28 \qquad \textbf{(D)}\ 32 \qquad \textbf{(E)}\ 35 == Solution 1 == By substitution, we have \begin{align*} (\text{wind chill}) &= 36 - 0.7 \times 18 \\ &= 36 - 12.6 \\ &= 23.4 \\ &\approx \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 23}. \end{align*} ~apex304, SohumUttamchandani, wuwang2002, TaeKim, Cxrupptedpat, MRENTHUSIASM == Solution 2 == 0.7 is very close to \frac{2}{3} - therefore, we can substitute \frac{2}{3} into the equation to get 36 - \frac{2}{3} \cdot 18 = 36 - 12 = 24. As \frac{2}{3} is slightly less than 0.7, the correct answer is slightly less than 24. Therefore, the answer is \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 23}. ~TheGoldenRetriever ==Solution 3== 0.7 is equivalent to 7/10. 7/10 times 18 is 126/10, which is 12.6. Since the air temperature is 36 degrees Fahrenheit, 36 - 12.6 is 23.4, which is the closest to \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ 23}. ~AliceDubbleYou ==Video Solution by CoolMathProblems== https://youtu.be/Pf93RGtKo1I?feature=shared&t=109 ==Video Solution (A Clever Explanation You’ll Get Instantly)== https://youtu.be/zntZrtsnyxc?si=nM5eWOwNU6HRdleZ&t=113 ~hsnacademy ==*Simple Video Explanation by MathTalks_Now*== https://studio.youtube.com/video/PMOeiGLkDH0/edit ==Video Solution (How to Creatively THINK!!!) == https://youtu.be/lVgjbLPvzt8 ~Education the Study of everything ==Video Solution by Math-X (Smart and Simple)== https://youtu.be/Ku_c1YHnLt0?si=OLOhPCvcHiZhLK6e&t=218 ~Math-X ==Video Solution by Magic Square== https://youtu.be/-N46BeEKaCQ?t=5606 ==Video Solution by SpreadTheMathLove== https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EcrktBc8zrM ==Video Solution by Interstigation== https://youtu.be/DBqko2xATxs&t=149 ==Video Solution by WhyMath== https://youtu.be/k5hyZnmya14 ~savannahsolver ==Video Solution by harungurcan== https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35BW7bsm_Cg&t=230s ~harungurcan ==Video Solution by Dr. David== https://youtu.be/O6CLQ5Lks3s ==Video Solution!
